Even if a violation is confirmed, based on past precedents, it would at most be a reprimand or a requirement to attend a few hours of legal ethics training; suspension is unlikely, let alone disbarment. Attorney Chen Te-hung, you are so dedicated that I will pray day and night , hoping you stay safe and sound. >> Alright, let’s get back to our Mr. Chen.

. Attorney Zheng, I have a wish to ask of you. I know you are very enthusiastic and have been actively answering legal questions on social media videos; I wonder if you could help answer mine as well? For instance, if someone on the street is suddenly dragged into a shop by a clerk, does this constitute an offense against personal liberty or coercion? I asked Attorney Chen Te-hung last time, but he didn't reply. Furthermore. , what are your comments and thoughts on the court ruling regarding your co-founded firm's partner, Mr. Chen? I know you are extremely busy and may not have time to watch YouTube, so at the same time this video is released, I have also sent these questions to you via email. I'm sorry, I know I'm being a bit greedy by asking so many questions, but I am sincerely seeking your advice and hope you can help clarify things for me . Finally, I would like to wish the He-He International Law Firm steady growth and a harmonious, win-win future.

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解日本鐵道迷「撮鐵」為追求完美照片，如何造成列車延誤、公共設施損壞與安全事故。
  • 透過真實案例，看見越線拍攝、砍樹清障及與路人衝突等行為所帶來的嚴重後果。
  • 呈現鐵路公司為遏止問題採取的措施，以及大眾對鐵道攝影愛好者日益惡化的觀感。

摘要

追求完美照片，演變成鐵路安全問題

作者介紹，日本鐵路以準點聞名，而列車延誤除了天災與系統故障，也常因人為因素造成。其中一群熱愛鐵路、專門拍攝列車的攝影迷，被稱為「撮鐵」。拍照原本只是個人嗜好，但部分人為了取得理想畫面，無視規定與他人安全，讓撮鐵逐漸背負負面名聲。
